column1: # Public types that have no outside evidence but stay public on purpose.
# `scripts/public-surface-inventory.py` reads this file: a type named here counts as
# "justified", not "unproven", and the signature closure spreads from it too.
# Format: <full name><TAB><reason - one sentence that names the concrete evidence>.
# A line without a reason is an error; the line of a type that is no longer public
# or that has found its own evidence is reported as a "stale reason" and gets deleted.
# These do NOT count as a reason to stay: being used in the BODY of another first-party
# package (InternalsVisibleTo solves that), being used in a test project, or the guess

column2: The documentation of the public AgentDefinitionCompiler.CompileParameterizedAsync tells a caller that has not validated the document to call AgentParameterValidator.ValidateValues first; the site describes a parameterized run compiled outside the catalog (write-your-own-agent-decorator).

A third-party store that implements the IApiKeyStore seam creates the key with ApiKeyGenerator.Generate, and ApiKeyAuthenticator looks the presented token up with ApiKeyGenerator.ComputeHash; the shipped ApiKeyStoreContract checks the `ap_` format and the lookup by this hash.
The XML documentation of IEvalStore.DiffRunsAsync tells the implementer to delegate to EvalRunDiffBuilder.Build instead of rewriting the comparison rules.

JobLanes.Resolve is called from every IJobStore.EnqueueAsync implementation (TraconSchedulingOptions.LaneByHandlerKey is applied inside it); the documentation of seven public types ties the lane dictionary to this type.

The IRetentionStore documentation says the target name comes from this allow list and that an unknown target is expected to throw ArgumentException; the shipped RetentionStoreContract asks the implementer to write rows under RetentionTargets.VoiceSessions.

The RunEventType.Custom documentation ties the CustomType rules that a consumer writes and the reserved prefix to this type; a consumer that turns on TraconQuotaOptions.PublishThresholdToRunStream recognizes the notification with RunEventCustomTypes.QuotaThreshold.
The wrapper that the [TraconTool] source generator emits calls this type, and that code enters the consumer's own assembly; InternalsVisibleTo does not work there.
In an agent that runs in-process with TraconRunOptions.Budget, this exception reaches consumer code from AIAgent.RunAsync/RunStreamingAsync without being converted.

When an IStructuredResponseValidator that the consumer registered rejects a response, this exception reaches the caller of the in-process AIAgent.RunAsync from RunRecordingAgent without being converted.

The documentation of the public TimeoutAIFunction says the wrapped call ends with this exception; a consumer that calls the tool directly or wraps it with its own function-invocation layer sees it by type.
